annotations.text:
HOME — opportunity-first (chosen)
The weekly opportunity owns the top no-scroll zone. Under it, a SMART quick-log card brings your most-likely entry up top — one tap to log your usual breakfast — so logging stays fast even though meals moved below the fold. Intake + vitals glance below; full logging via the floating +.

SMART LOGGING
The add-food sheet leads with suggestions from your own history: your usual meal for this slot (one tap = add all) and your most-frequent single items, each one tap. Recents & search sit below. This is recents/favorites made predictive — it removes redundant taps, but you still confirm, so the awareness stays.

THE REFLECT SURFACE
Reached from the opportunity card or a Pulse tab. Window toggle (7/14/30d), movement, sleep, and the weight TREND together — the 'more than remaining macros' view.

WEIGHT, REWORKED
A smoothed TREND line (not raw daily) is the signal; the projection uses your recent-window trend, not a 2-point all-time slope; weigh-in is inline. Daily dots stay faint.

ALTERNATES (kept for reference)
The two directions we didn't pick. ③ Dashboard-first became the Home above. Time-aware mix is parked for a future iteration.
